title: dynamic-qa Named Data Set v1
description: Strict, versioned contract for one Named Data Set file (qa/data/<data-set-id>.yaml). The filename equals the immutable, semantic data-set ID. A Named Data Set is separated from Flow intent so cases stay reusable across flows and environments (DESIGN-dynamic-qa-spec.md §5.2, SPEC-135.md user stories 25-26). Values are non-secret and environment-neutral: secret values, selectors, URLs, commands, and adapter configuration are forbidden. A field may name an approved secret handle by ID, never carry its value. This document is the human-readable contract; dynamic-qa/shared/scripts/named-data-set.mjs is the hand-written fail-closed validator that enforces it (no JSON Schema validator dependency is added — see dynamic-qa/DECISIONS.md and the run brief's deterministic-core decision). Secret-value detection there is a mix of exact structural rules and necessarily heuristic pattern matching; see that module's header comment for exactly which is which.

schema.description: Immutable. Any other value, including a plausible future version string, is an unsupported-schema-version error, not a silent upgrade attempt.

id.description: Immutable, semantic, kebab-case Named Data Set ID. Must equal the file's basename without extension. Never derived from an issue number; never reused; never renamed.

revision.description: Monotonically increasing per data-set ID. A single file's validator can only check that this is a positive integer; monotonic non-decrease across revisions is a cross-file provenance/drift-gate concern, not this schema's (mirrors the Flow Definition schema's revision note).

cases.description: Named cases. Order is not meaningful (cases are addressed by id, not position), but is preserved rather than reordered.

id.description: Stable semantic case id, unique within this data set.

propertyNames.description: Must be usable as the <field> in a Flow's scalar '${case.<field>}' substitution.

additionalProperties.description: Either a non-secret scalar value, or an approved-secret-handle reference. Never a URL, selector, command, or adapter-configuration value, and never a secret value.

secret_handle.description: Names an approved secret handle owned by the Execution Profile. The value itself never appears here.
